name: typescript
description: Language-wide TypeScript guidance for full-stack frameworks, backend services, libraries, scripts, and frontend code. Use when modeling domain states, narrowing values, designing useful generics, validating runtime boundaries, reviewing assertions or suppressions, matching compiler contracts, or improving TypeScript-specific code quality, TypeScript AST tooling, or selecting the collected TypeScript practices. Component/native wrapper props and browser-specific storage, URL, postMessage, and form behavior are outside its language-wide scope.
